items.title: Blocking malicious npm packages before and during installation
items.snippet: Vercel now checks for blocked npm packages before and during dependency installation in builds , helping prevent malicious install scripts from running. The checks use a blocklist of specific package

items.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
items.snippet: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll to advise on responsible AI for national security modernization, cyber resilience, and collaboration with U.S. allies.
